proof.amplitude: The private source supplies the exact projected moving matrix, damping, nonzero initial datum and original P. The checked decomposition has first diagonal zero and second diagonal -2lambda, up to E_actual-(d-dref)I. Its infinity logarithmic norm is at most (2E+Ed)/S, so the full Volterra limit satisfies ||w||<=W. No finite partial sum is used.
proof.jets: The finite power ledger differentiates the original n, K, Aphi, U, J, B, Bleft and projected matrix. All divisions retain the original uniform normal/c0 lower bounds. Apply w_(m+1)=sum binom M_(j)w_(m-j), P_prime=(lambda-dref)P, then t=B*P*w. Constants depend on the requested finite order; the small-q threshold does not change.
proof.cutoff: The original psi=sigma_2(20v/Ls-4)*sigma_2(16-20v/Ls) equals one on [Ls/4,3Ls/4]. Every differentiated tail term includes a positive psi derivative and is supported at distance at least Ls/4 from the midpoint. Hence P<=exp(-gaussianLower*Ls/16)<=exp(-a*ell^2), with a=r0*Renv^-31/(32u)>0.
proof.originalStep: Each fixed step derivative is bounded by 1+integral_0^1(sigma_2^(j+1))^2, by FTC and Cauchy-Schwarz. Leibniz gives the exact cutoff constants, including powers 20^j and the inverse length. The latter is at most one because the original selector imposes Ls>=1.
proof.countAndFlat: The all-integer mesh count and finite palette are independent of the pulse instance. Gaussian decay beats each prescribed ell power and q inverse power by the displayed completed Young square. The positive infinite tail uses (J+d)^2-J^2>=(2J+1)d. This arithmetic never sets a tail to zero.
proof.limits: This packet establishes the actual bare homogeneous tail and fast-v jets on the authenticated terminal domain. Covariance square-root/slow-cutoff derivatives, all-label amplitude authentication, physical pullback losses, same-label nonlinear products and the final global residual remain separate.

mesh.countProof: A source box at band ell has mesh center a/ell^6 and intersects |R|<=2sqrt(Xb), |Z|<=2, |T|<=2. Thus |a_j|<=M_j ell^6+3/4. Each coordinate has at most (2M_j+3)ell^6 integers; the product contributes ell^18. Multiply by two sign rectangles only once.
mesh.pointOverlapProof: The original one-dimensional bump has strict support |x-j|<3/4. At most two integers are positive at each real x. All boundary jets are zero, so the same count bounds nonzero fixed-label derivative terms.
